title: Confirm-pass verdicts (FR-9.5)
description: Diff-scoped confirm output: the reviewer judges, per prior finding, whether the commit-range diff addressed it. `new_findings` lets the confirm pass surface a regression it noticed in the diff without re-reviewing the whole phase, AND carry the concrete unresolved remainder of a `partially_resolved` accepted finding (pipeline-effectiveness FR-6.1, P9). Strict-mode/compat note (review F-007 — same rule as findings.json): because `new_findings` is emitted through the strict `--output-schema` path, each item lists EVERY findings-schema field plus `carried_from` in `required`, with `carried_from` spelled required-but-nullable (`null` for an ordinary diff regression, a `<finding-id>` for a carried remainder). Backward compatibility is preserved through the persisted-artifact validation path, not by omitting the field: `new_findings` is already a required top-level array, so a pre-migration confirm output with an EMPTY `new_findings` validates unchanged, and the engine's read path treats a pre-`carried_from` entry as `carried_from: null` (an ordinary regression).

new_findings.description: Defects visible in the round's diff itself (scope: the diff, nothing else), AND carried remainders (FR-6.1): each entry is a COMPLETE findings-schema object plus `carried_from`. For an ordinary diff regression, `carried_from` is null. For the concrete unresolved remainder of a `partially_resolved` accepted finding, `carried_from` names that finding's id; the engine then assigns the entry a deterministic reserved-namespace id and merges it into the next round as a pre-accepted fix obligation (no re-triage).

id.description: The confirmer's id for this entry. For a carried remainder the engine OVERWRITES it with the reserved-namespace id `<carried_from>-r<round>-c<N>`; supply any placeholder.

location.description: File and line/section reference — the SPECIFIC remainder for a carried entry, not the whole parent.

claim.description: What is wrong — the specific unresolved remainder for a carried entry.

suggested_fix.description: Optional per §7 — null when the confirmer offers none.

carried_from.description: FR-6.1: the `partially_resolved` accepted finding id this entry is the remainder of, or null for an ordinary diff regression. Required-but-nullable for strict native structured output (the same convention `suggested_fix` uses).
